hypothesis.statement: The source-lock receipt can be independently regenerated from the pinned base without producer narrative.
hypothesis.supported_claim: Every derived field of workstreams/po03/evidence/source-lock.json (byte count, SHA-256, Git blob name for all six declared sources) is reproducible from Git object storage alone, and the complete receipt is byte-identical to the committed blob when the non-derivable declarative fields are supplied.
hypothesis.boundary: Reproduction succeeds only against the tree at the receipt's own head_sha (7b9ee3e). The declarative fields (repository, branch, head_sha, version, decision_changed, and the ordered path list) are not derivable from any tree and had to be supplied as a spec, so this experiment establishes reproducibility of the receipt's measurements, not of its declaration.
hypothesis.refuted_claim: The receipt is not valid at the current base head. Verified against f5b758f, three of six declared sources have drifted, so a receipt carrying no validity scope silently misrepresents the current tree.
